name: tiktok-ads-mcp
display_name: TikTok for Business (TikTok Ads Manager) MCP
description: TikTok for Business (TikTok Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, updat

platform_mcp_tiktok_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_tiktok_access_token.description: Long-term advertiser access token from the TikTok API for Business authorization flow (/oauth2/access_token/), sent as the `Access-Token` header.

platform_mcp_tiktok_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_APP_ID
platform_mcp_tiktok_app_id.description: Developer app id (Application Management page); sent as a query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

platform_mcp_tiktok_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_SECRET
platform_mcp_tiktok_secret.description: The developer app's secret, sent as the `secret` query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

platform_mcp_tiktok_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_tiktok_advertiser_id.description: Advertiser (ad account) id that update_budget writes to (campaign/update requires advertiser_id in the body).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /oauth2/advertiser/get/?app_id&secret returns {code, message, data: {list: [{advertiser_id, advertiser_name}]}}. TikTok answers HTTP 200 with a non-zero `code` on failure: check code == 0.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Advertiser accounts that authorised the app. Currency is not in this response (GET /advertiser/info/ has it). A non-zero `code` in a 200 body yields an empty list.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /campaign/get/?advertiser_id&page&page_size (1-1000). `status` is operation_status ENABLE|DISABLE (secondary_status in raw); `budget` is in the account currency and its meaning follows budget_mode (BUDGET_MODE_DAY daily, BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL lifetime, BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE none). The `status` argument is not sent (filtering is a JSON object).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Synchronous basic report, campaign level, one row per campaign per day (YYYY-MM-DD, closed interval, ad account time zone); metrics are strings. `campaign_id` is not applied (the filter is a JSON array of objects); filter the rows instead. Up to 1,000 rows (page 1).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /campaign/update/ {advertiser_id (config), campaign_id, budget}. The value replaces the campaign budget in its current budget_mode (daily only for BUDGET_MODE_DAY campaigns), in the account currency; `currency` is ignored. A failed update (non-zero code, empty data) is reported as invalid_input.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /campaign/status/update/ {advertiser_id (config), campaign_ids: [campaign_id], operation_status: DISABLE (pause) | ENABLE (resume)}; answers {code, data: {status, campaign_ids}}. Deleted campaigns cannot change status. A non-zero code (empty data) is reported as invalid_input.
